nodes.name: Góc giữa hai mặt phẳng
nodes.description: Góc giữa hai mặt phẳng trong không gian, được xác định bởi góc giữa hai đường thẳng tương ứng vuông góc với mỗi mặt phẳng.

assignments.rationale: Both occurrences describe the same geometric concept of the angle between two planes in space. The grade difference (11 vs 12) is not a reason to split. The descriptions are consistent, with the 11th-grade version providing a more detailed definition and the 12th-grade version being a concise restatement.
